reviewedChanges.finding: Remote URL parent/path fragments use RegExp.escape; finite templates, maximum 12 inputs, six alternatives and 2048-character path bound. Parser replay ignores report-supplied regex strings and selects only exact ID/URL code-owned patterns or escaped paths derived from the bounded current response.
reviewedChanges.evidence: Actual hostile /(a+)+/ fixture matches the literal parent and does not match repeated a text; dated and language-prefixed routes remain supported.

reviewedChanges.finding: Both research and finalization check candidate ID before file access. A fixed directory plus 1-100 lowercase alphanumeric/hyphen ID plus .json rejects separators, traversal and prototype special keys.
Accumulation now uses Map.set/get. Object.fromEntries occurs only for final JSON serialization after checked IDs; there is no dynamic assignment to an inherited object property.

Methods are allowlisted per platform; credential path delimiters are rejected before fetch, URL is parsed and HTTPS/host/no-auth/no-port/no-query/no-fragment are checked. Redirects remain disabled. Valid Telegram bot-token colon and fixed native method paths remain unchanged; invalid endpoint construction is classified before any provider write.
